purpose: Separate the behavioral direction labels from the confidence signal that also drives the online controller.

basis.evidence: Current over/under direction labels mix reflection lexicon hits and confidence quantiles; the same confidence statistic determines online action.
SEAL provides execution/reflection/transition classes. Official source b2ad6858fc48143021e5df5ce10396f5c693b1ec uses execution mean minus pooled reflection/transition mean.

basis.derivation: Our proposed hybrid uses SEAL's lexical labeling rule on exactly the original ReBalance complete-step support, and its opposite contrast for the sign convention of the existing dynamic controller. This isolates label/orientation changes; it is not the already completed static SEAL comparison or a faithful SEAL reproduction.

exact_change.support: All84008 original complete-step first-content states at hidden_state_index21, unchanged question/step weights. Do not change to SEAL delimiter states, include additional incomplete tails, filter correctness, or regenerate answers.
exact_change.labels: Apply the verified official SEAL generate_index lexical check/transition conditions to each original step's decoded text. Reflection has precedence over transition; all remaining steps are execution. Preserve author spellings and substring semantics.
exact_change.direction: d_new=mean(reflection union transition)-mean(execution), scaled once to the Euclidean norm of the frozen originalraw vector. Negative original coefficients then point toward execution; positive ones toward pooled reflection/transition.
exact_change.runtime: Replace vector bytes only; retain outputlayer20, all original curve parameters and maximum-probability arithmetic controller, generation boundary routing and sampling. No coefficient refit or combination with another candidate.

diagnostic: Report class counts, label overlaps with original mixed classes, original-vector cosine, group agreement and joined existing76 content judgments. These judgments are a stratified single-reviewer development audit, not ground truth or independent correctness evidence. Do not tune labels/norm/strength based on them.
risks: Lexical reflection markers also occur in useful checking and correction; their removal is not automatically safe.
Execution labels include unlabeled redundant prose and wrong calculations.
The original curve was calibrated for its original contrast. Matching vector norm controls scale but does not preserve its fitted linear-separator meaning.
The completed static SEAL comparison had an accuracy loss against dynamic ReBalance on its100 training questions; a hybrid has no demonstrated advantage. Fresh evaluation is required.
GPU_if_CPU_passes: Prepare one fresh100-question original/candidate pair, same source/model/runtime,16000 maximum new tokens. Require>=5percent thinking and total-token reduction, no fewer correct and no more caps. Stop on failure without layer, strength or vocabulary search. Reserve200 independent questions only for confirming a frozen passing candidate within a separately fixed batch budget.
resources: All needed states, tokenizer and official source are local. No GPU, SSH, new answers or hidden-state replay needed for this fit.
